messages:
sara: Heads up — prepping a coordinated cutover tonight at 23:00 PT. Services involved: api, runtime, console, router. I put a short runbook here: https://go/runbooks/svc-cutover. Please confirm pins and rollback triggers.
kevin: Ack. Router header-split will be staged. plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% over three windows (10m each). Who's owning the header swap?
priya: I can own header swap and router observability. Will watch p50/p95 and 5xx delta. If 5xx > +1% or p95 > +200ms during a window, we stop and rollback.
michael: Runtime: switching kernel-quantization profile v2.1 -> v2.2 (nonbreaking). We'll pin model variant to v20240614. If memory GC or OOMs spike, immediate rollback to v2.1.
sara: Console and API changes are config-only (feature flags). We'll keep console on old behavior until runtime fully green. API will route a small percentage by header.
deploybot: deploybot: deploy scheduled by @sara for 2024-06-14T23:00:00Z. ID: deploy-1749876500-01. Stages: api -> runtime -> router -> console. Automated canary checks enabled.
kevin: Quick note: add a 5m ramp between api -> runtime to let kv caches warm. Otherwise prefix cache misses will spike.
priya: +1. Also placing short-circuit fallback: if runtime fails canary we route API -> backup-model (v2.0) automatically. Need ops-oncall to acknowledge.
ops-oncall: I see the plan. I'll be on standby at 22:50 PT and will escalate if we hit rollback criteria. Please DM on-call channel when you start traffic shifts.
michael: Rollback playbook (short):
```
- step 1: pause traffic via deploybot
- step 2: pin runtime to previous kernel/profile v2.1
- step 3: route api to backup-model v2.0
- step 4: monitor 10m; if stable, resume; else open incident
```
priya: Where do we record the exact metric thresholds? I can add them to the runbook quick.
sara: Added thresholds to runbook: p95 +200ms, p50 +100ms, 5xx delta +1% absolute, error-rate SLI breach. Link updated.
kevin: For the router, also watch route split convergence on each shard; if any shard lags >30s, we pause and pin back.
deploybot: deploybot: preflight checks passed (image hashes, schema compatibility, config locks). Lock token: lock-1749876500.
ops-oncall: Confirmed. I'll post in #incidents when we start the first stage and tag @oncall.
sara: Final checklist: 22:45 quiet window, 22:50 oncall watches, 22:55 final lock, 23:00 start api -> 23:10 runtime -> 23:20 router -> 23:30 console. If any manual rollback, call it immediately and assign incident lead. :thumbsup:
kevin: LGTM. If we see a small regression but bounded, prefer staged pause and targetted rollback rather than full fanout rollback.
priya: I'll handle quick rollback script for header-swap (one command). Pasting here: `./scripts/rollback-header.sh --env prod --id deploy-1749876500-01`
michael: Copy that, I'll have runtime pin ready: `runtimectl pin --instance all --profile v2.1`
ops-oncall: Good. I'll be ready to flip the backup-model route if needed. Ping me when you start the router stage.
sara: Thanks team. I'll kick at 23:00 PT and update thread as we go. If you want to watch metrics: https://telemetry/svc-cutover/dashboards/cross-svc
kevin: Thanks — see you tonight. :coffee:
